profile_text.body:
SS&C Blue Prism is a London-headquartered automation company founded in 2001 and backed by SS&C Technologies. The company describes itself as a leader in agentic AI, robotic process automation, and business process management, and says its technology has evolved beyond traditional intelligent automation and digital workers toward what it calls agentic process automation. Its stated aim is to make AI agents operational within enterprise environments, combining RPA's rules-based execution layer with AI-driven decision-making to handle more complex, judgment-based work.

The company's core platform is SS&C Blue Prism WorkHQ, described as an agentic automation platform evolved from its earlier intelligent automation platform, designed to unify human, digital, and AI-driven work. It works alongside SS&C Blue Prism Chorus for enterprise-wide AI orchestration and the SS&C AI Gateway, which the company positions as a governance framework for AI integration, featuring audit trails, role-based access control, guardrails, built-in business rules, and real-time risk notifications. The company says deployments are tested and validated through its SS&C Innovation Lab.

The site's held facts record the flagship product as Blue Prism, categorized as enterprise RPA with a digital workforce and centralized control, noted as UK-hosted and GDPR relevant. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
